title: Activity Feed
description: Timeline of events composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Avatar, Button, Card, Alert and Skeleton primitives: one row per event with the actor's avatar, what they did and when, an optional comment and row action, joined by a rail; with its own empty, loading and error renders; responds to its container (@container) across all three contract steps — the header lines up and comments stop being cut at @sm, each timestamp moves to the trailing edge at @md, and into a leading time column at @lg.
